doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Zustand 4.x chosen for state management. Lightweight with persist middleware for localStorage. Works well with React Server Components (hydration-safe). Selector pattern for optimized re-renders.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Weight formula: weight_kg = (width × height × depth) × density / 1,000,000. Price formula: price_cents = basePricePerCm3 × volume × finishModifier.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Stores in src/stores/configStore.ts and cartStore.ts. Hooks in src/hooks/ including usePriceCalculation.ts and useWeightCalculation.ts. Constants in src/constants/marbles.ts and shipping.ts.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: System automatically calculates and displays cube weight based on dimensions and marble density.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: System automatically calculates and displays price based on dimensions, marble type, and finish.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Price and weight calculations update in real-time (< 200ms).

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Configurator shows product price only + weight indicator. Always show weight in configurator to help user understand shipping impact. Price formatting follows locale conventions.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: AC: Store manages marbleId, dimensions, finish, calculatedWeight, calculatedPrice. Derived values recalculate automatically. State persists to localStorage. URL param initializes marbleId.

doc.title: Story 3.1 (Predecessor)
doc.snippet: ConfiguratorClient exists at src/components/configurator/ConfiguratorClient.tsx. Zustand store partially exists with basic fields and persist middleware. Marble validation ready via validateMarbleSlug.

doc.title: Database Schema
doc.snippet: Marble model includes density (Float, kg/m³) and basePricePerCm3 (Int, cents). MarbleFinish has priceModifier (Float, default 1.0). FinishType enum: POLISHED, HONED, RAW, BRUSHED.

constraints.constraint: Use Zustand selector pattern for optimized re-renders in consuming components
Stores must handle SSR/hydration properly - skip persist on server
Use constants for client-side data - avoid runtime DB queries in store
Calculations must complete within 200ms of input change
Files: camelCase with Store suffix (configStore.ts), hooks: camelCase with use prefix
Use generated Prisma enums (FinishType) from src/generated/prisma/enums
localStorage key must be 'marmorani-config', exclude derived values from persistence

interface.name: ConfigState
ConfigActions
MarbleData
calculateWeight
interface.signature: function calculateWeight(width: number, height: number, depth: number, density: number): number
interface.notes: Returns weight in kg. Formula: (width × height × depth) × density / 1,000,000

interface.name: calculatePrice
interface.signature: function calculatePrice(volume: number, basePricePerCm3: number, finishModifier: number): number
interface.notes: Returns price in cents. Formula: volume × basePricePerCm3 × finishModifier
